name: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B
summary: The best-documented 100B-class single-Spark recipe. Albond's INT4+FP8 hybrid lands at about 67GB resident with MTP-2 and 256K context, and he publishes both throughput and quality peaks rather than only one.
notes: Reported 52 tok/s and a 54.9 LongCode peak by the builder; not measured on our box.
Runs under vLLM from the builder's repo, not from a stock engine launch.
